description: Versioned amendment to research_v2_execution.json correcting code-hash path rule and recording bounded authorization for v2 selection grid run over the frozen candidate set (design deliverable only).

amends.note: The execution protocol itself is immutable and not edited; this amendment records corrections and bounds as separate, self-hashed design state.

code_hash_constraint.description: Corrects the code-hash constraint stated in research_v2_execution.json: compute_code_hash() hashes every .py file under src/breakout_research recursively. Paths under src/breakout_research/ are inside the hashed set; any new v2 execution code placed under src/breakout_research would change the code hash and invalidate the v1 campaign authorization.
code_hash_constraint.chosen_approach: Do not add v2 execution code under src/breakout_research/. If execution logic is required in future, it must live outside the hashed set (e.g. new top-level modules/scripts not under src/breakout_research/, or a separate entrypoint namespace explicitly confirmed outside the hashed tree). The v1 campaign authorization remains unchanged as long as no files under src/breakout_research are created or modified.
code_hash_constraint.superseded_protocol_text_note: The text in configs/research_v2_execution.json naming src/breakout_research/v2/ as 'outside the hashed set' is incorrect; that error is preserved as historical evidence in the protocol artifact (its hash remains aa902aa935cfb71cce72bd643bb9685333860ec5470b02b12282c0f1659d67e6).

v2_selection_authorization.purpose: Design-only record of bounded authorization parameters for a future v2 selection grid run over the frozen candidate set. No grid, backtest, campaign, selection, or pilot is executed by this amendment.
stopping_conditions: No candidate survives the unchanged v1 selection rule → report the outcome (do not hide it)
Any boundary violation → abort and rollback
v2_selection_authorization.rollback_rule: Do not write to v1 artifacts; remove any newly created v2 artifacts if execution is aborted; do not alter checkpoint.json or v1 campaign state.
falsifiers: Any modification to src/breakout_research/ (would change code_hash)
Reading any candle in the v2 confirmatory window during selection
Mixing v1 cycle-0 units with v2 results

durability.note: Becomes durable only when committed; artifact hash is canonical.

canonicalization.note: manifest_hash is computed over the canonical JSON body with manifest_hash field removed (following the pattern used by other v2 artifacts).
